description: This file defines a Blazor component named ToastComponent used to display toast notifications in a web application. It manages toast visibility, styling, and message content based on events from a ToastService.

classes.name: ToastComponent
classes.description: A Blazor component that displays toast notifications, subscribing to events from ToastService to show and hide toast messages.

methods.name: OnInitialized
methods.description: Overridden method that initializes the component and subscribes to toast events.

methods.name: ShowToast
methods.description: Handles the display of toast notifications with message and level, updating UI accordingly.

methods.name: BuildToastSettings
methods.description: Configures CSS classes and heading based on toast level.

methods.name: Dispose
methods.description: Unsubscribes from toast events to prevent memory leaks.
